messages.subject: Put a shiny application using slidify.
parts:
Hi!

Is possible to put an shiny application using the slidify without using rCharts. I'm trying to put a graph using the graphics packages in my presentation slidify unsuccessfully. I'll put in my resume script.

```{r opts.label = 'shiny'}
slidifyUI(
  sidebarPanel(
    sliderInput('n', 
                'Tamanho da população', 
               min = 2,
               max = 500,
               value = 3),
    
    checkboxInput("showcurve", "Mostrar curva", FALSE)  
  ),
  mainPanel(
#tags$div(id = 'hist',class='shiny-html-output nvd3 rChart')
tags$div(id = 'hist', class='shiny-plot-output')            
  )
)
```   

app1.R

require(fdth)

output$hist <- renderPlot({
  tab = fdt(rnorm(input$n, 
                  1.75, 
                  0.1))
  n1 <- plot(tab,
             ylab = 'Frequência absoluta',
             xlab = 'Intervalo de classes')
  n1$set(dom = 'hist', width = 600)
  n1
})

Thank's!
